Title: Microsoft Azure Attestation is now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Attestation is a unified solution for remotely verifying the trustworthiness of a platform and integrity of the binaries running inside it. The service supports attestation of the platforms backed by Trusted Platform Modules (TPMs) alongside the ability to attest the state of Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) such as Intel® Software Guard Extensions (SGX) enclaves and Virtualization-based Security (VBS) enclaves. 

To learn more, visit Azure Attestation documentation.
